name: auth-sign-up
title: Account registration screen
description: Native sign-up form and next-step guidance with real host routes.

files.content:
CREATE YOUR ACCOUNT

Start your workspace

Use your work email to create an account. The server must validate identity and credentials.

Use at least 12 characters. Configure rate limiting, secure sessions and CSRF protection server-side.

Already have an account? Sign in

What comes next

  1. Verify your email.
  2. Name your workspace.
  3. Invite teammates when ready.

Email verification help
